title: Stochastic Stability of Nonlinear MPPI via Contraction Theory and Control Lyapunov Functions
summary: Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control is directly implementable on nonlinear systems because its online update requires only forward rollouts of the dynamics, not gradients, linearizations, or convex optimization. However, this algorithmic flexibility does not by itself provide a closed-loop stability certificate. This paper establishes such a certificate through a stability-inheritance argument.
